description: Which organisations notified US regulators of a data breach, when, and how many residents?. Official breach notices from US state attorney-general lists (CA, WA, OR, DE, more being added), HHS OCR and SEC 8-K Item 1.05, merged into one row per event across regulators. Facts and official links only; no breached data. Routes: /org (org*); /events (since, until, state, min_affected, org, limit); /coverage. Paid $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.
